title: Why Copying AI for Sermons is a Bad Idea @SlaveckMoraru  #shorts
description:
Never copy-paste directly from AI like ChatGPT or Claude into your sermons. Even if the content is correct, there's an undetectable 'off' quality that audiences can sense, a human aesthetic AI struggles to replicate.
#AIWriting #SermonPrep #Homiletics #ChurchTech
